$comment: Product lock file of the sellable kit: one product version pins one hardware tag and one firmware tag. See product/README.md and VERSIONS.md.
name: Kibble Dispenser Outdoor

kit.electronics: electronics module case 1.0, assembled and tested, slid into the pre-assembled chassis
contents: chassis, pre-assembled and closed (pod, dosing core, drive, servo in its sealed bay, cap, chassis harness)
electronics module case 1.0 with the control panel (push-button, 2 LEDs with light pipes, speaker with acoustic membrane)
flange set, pre-assembled (two flange plates, dowel pin, gate blade, interlock ring, skirt lip) and the cable grommet
funnel collar, shelf gasket, 4 wood screws 5x35, 12 V supply cable with M8 connector, UV cable tie, drilling template

notes: No product release yet. The first, product-v1.0.0, will pin a tested hardware release, the electronics module that fits it and a firmware release that has run on it. Hardware 6.4 needs the one-button firmware of issue #2.
Changes that only touch the kit (enclosure, packaging, manual) bump the product version without a new hardware or firmware tag.
